featured_reviews.review_text: One of the solidest gyms in Bhandup. I’ve been working out here for a few months now and the vibe is actually really good. Highly recommend this gym to anyone serious about fitness!

featured_reviews.name: cijo jose
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training at Volt Fitness for the past 4 months, and the experience has been really positive thanks to my trainer, Sachin.

Sachin sir has strong expertise in yoga, power yoga, TRX suspension training, functional workouts, and nutrition, which reflects clearly in the way he plans sessions. Each workout feels structured, purposeful, and tailored to my progress.

With his consistent guidance and push, I’ve managed to lose 4 kg so far. What stands out most is the extra effort he puts in every single day to ensure I stay on track and keep improving.

If you’re looking for a dedicated and knowledgeable trainer who genuinely invests in your progress, I would definitely recommend training with Sachin sir at Volt Fitness.

I’ve had a fantastic experience training with Shailesh at Volt Fitness. He’s incredibly knowledgeable, professional, and genuinely passionate about helping people reach their fitness goals. What really stands out is his ability to tailor workouts to individual needs while still pushing you to give your best.

Shailesh creates a motivating and positive environment that makes every session enjoyable, even the tough ones. He pays close attention to form, technique, and progress, ensuring you get the most out of every workout while staying injury-free.

His dedication, energy, and supportive attitude make a huge difference. Whether you’re a beginner or someone experienced, Shailesh knows exactly how to guide you. Highly recommend him to anyone looking for a top-quality trainer — definitely a 5-star experience!
